blockers: Channel-specific auth, quotas, rights, storage, narration and review are unprobed.
Current host release, workers and migrations require existing release diagnostics.
A larger acquisition allowance does not expand measured scene-index capacity.
Semantic retrieval and temporal verification require independent media evaluation.

capabilities.execution_location: Katcha server; independent of the browser running Katcha

interactive_browser.coverage: Server-side Chromium: JavaScript, forms, tabs, screenshots and cookies
limitations: Sessions expire after 15 idle minutes or a browser service restart
Sign-in must happen in this server session; local browser cookies are not copied
Public HTTPS only; media access does not establish usage rights or scene verification
interactive_browser.verification_scope: A live Chromium health check does not verify external site access or video content

measured_scene_index.next_action: Use the existing rights-gated project media index. Larger or longer media requires bounded windowed analysis, not higher host limits.

media_download.authentication_help: Public videos normally need no sign-in. YouTube can still challenge the server request. An authorized server session may help but cannot guarantee access; try another accessible approved source. Client-browser sign-in does not authenticate the worker.
media_download.dependency_check_location: API/goal process, not a probe of the ingestion worker
media_download.live_download_note: No external media transfer is performed by this capability check

optional_semantic_inspection.next_action: Verify channel inspection permission, provider and budget admission; enabled dispatch alone does not prove inference or temporal understanding.

public_page_reading.coverage: Public HTTPS HTML/text, with timestamp and content hash
limitations: No interactive JavaScript or signed-in browser sessions
Page text does not verify video contents

scene_verification.limitations: Search metadata and sampled stills cannot confirm an action through time, episode attribution, or rights clearance.

evidence_scope: local source/configuration; browser health only if requested
next_action: Review docs/AUTONOMOUS_E2E_IMPLEMENTATION.md; use existing live acceptance runners only after their specific authorization gates are satisfied.
